name: tippecanoe
description: Build vector tilesets (MBTiles/PMTiles) at scale from large GeoJSON, CSV, and FlatGeobuf inputs

install_steps: sudo apt-get install -y build-essential libsqlite3-dev zlib1g-dev
git clone https://github.com/felt/tippecanoe.git /tmp/tippecanoe && cd /tmp/tippecanoe && make -j$(nproc) && sudo make install

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install tippecanoe: build from source (https://github.com/felt/tippecanoe) or brew install tippecanoe

commands.description: Build a vector tileset from GeoJSON/FlatGeobuf/CSV (e.g. -o out.mbtiles in.geojson -z14, or -o out.pmtiles). Key flags: -zg auto-zoom, --drop-densest-as-needed, --coalesce-densest-as-needed, -l layer name

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install tippecanoe: build from source (https://github.com/felt/tippecanoe) or brew install tippecanoe

commands.description: Decode an MBTiles archive or PBF tile back to GeoJSON for inspection (tippecanoe-decode)

commands.description: Join or filter multiple MBTiles archives into one (tile-join). Use -o out.mbtiles and input files
